reason: I travel twice a month and always leave my pills on the nightstand, so a pre-counted foil sachet I can toss in my bag is the first version of this that fits my life. The lab report on the box and the $24.99 launch price make it an easy one-box try.
objection: It is still two capsules every night and I will forget, so I may end up with half a box sitting in a drawer for $25. I also can't tell yet if I will actually feel anything from magnesium.
would_change_my_mind: If it were more than $30 for one box, or if the lab report turned out to be a generic page and not for my batch, I would skip it.
